spiritgiven.comments: The game was an intense battle but well spirited and all players were respectful throughout. There were a lot of repeated pick and travel calls; although uncontested, it would be appreciated to try and avoid these scenarios. Overall, a positive and skilled team to play against.

spiritreceived.comments:
About body contact: Little bit much Step of foot
Nice communication

Rules- They are occassionally not aware, and need some explaination of the rules, but retract after clarification, receptive

Fouls/Body contact- They are physical and use their hands, abit of excessive contact

Fair Mindlessness-First half sidelines have some instances that they were interfering with the game, giving comments without perspective being asked, after feedback. Improved on it.
Lady coach abit excessive in interfering with the game.

Positive attitude and self-control increased to 3 on 24/7 (with spirit director) - Canada were very understanding about their calls, they were very willing to receive and act on feedback.

Canada mixed, Thank you so much for this high intensity, spirited and overal fun game. We really enjoyed playing you. As we said in the spirit circle you really did well on fouls and body contact, even in the layouts you did you barely touched us. We really liked you energy on the field but also on the sideline. Your communication was very nice and the calls were resolved very quickly. Again thank you sonmuch for this amazing game and good luck for the rest of the tournament.
Greetings NED mixed

Team Canada had good level of physicality considering the intensity of the game. There were a few times they called picks that could have been avoided by them, but overall good communication and great game.
Some instances of unnecessary calls, abit of non incidental contact, overall good game.
